name: io.github.cardtest15-coder/word-mcp-live
title: Word MCP Live
description: MCP server for Microsoft Word — 195 tools: 115 cross-platform (python-docx) + 80 live (COM/JXA). Live editing, tracked changes, per-action undo, comments, formatting, export.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHOR
environmentVariables.description: Author name shown on tracked changes and comments (default: Author)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHOR_INITIALS
environmentVariables.description: Author initials shown on comments (default: empty)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Colon-separated list of allowed directories for file access (default: all)
